meta.description: Stacked or overlapping avatars used to show participant lists — conversation members, shared documents, collaboration indicators.

verdict.title: Keep — all structural issues resolved
verdict.text: All four DS Health traits pass and nothing is open. layout has semantic values, an overflow variant covers groups larger than four, and the inner avatars are instances of the canonical Avatar.

overview.inContextNote: How the avatar group appears in a real product screen — conversation list where grouped chats display stacked avatars (DX Team, David's Surprise Party) alongside single-avatar threads.

Properties
layout

traits.name: Reusable
traits.note: Fits participant lists and collaboration indicators. 4 variants (pair/trio/quad/overflow) cover 2–4 visible avatars plus "+N" overflow for larger groups. Fixed 48×48 container — suitable for most list/row contexts.

traits.name: Self-contained
traits.note: Group carries its own overlap positioning, border overlap treatment, and fixed dimensions. All colors token-bound.

traits.name: Consistent
traits.note: Property renamed from no. of initals → layout with semantic values (pair/trio/quad/overflow). C2 resolved. Inherits the main/avatar/brand/intials typo from Avatar's shared variable collection (tracked under Avatar, not an Avatar Group blocker).

traits.name: Composable
traits.note: All inner avatars are instances of the canonical Avatar component (17143:4488). Changes to Avatar now propagate to Avatar Group automatically. Compositional inheritance restored.

behavior.notes: 3 avatars + "+N" badge in bottom-right slot. Uses the same default/light style as the avatar it replaces.
Display-only. Tap behavior handled by parent container.

resolved.body: Property renamed: no. of initals → layout with semantic values (pair/trio/quad/overflow). Fixes typo, removes spaces/dots, replaces pseudo-numeric strings with true enum values. Maps cleanly to SwiftUI EBAvatarGroupLayout.pair/.trio/.quad/.overflow / Compose EBAvatarGroupLayout.Pair etc. C2 Fixed
Overflow variant layout=overflow added — bottom-right slot shows "+N" badge instead of a 4th avatar. Handles groups larger than 4. C5 Fixed

Inner avatars repointed via instance swap to the canonical Avatar component (17143:4488). Previously referenced a duplicate Avatar at 21:94766 — now all 4 variants inherit from the canonical source. Compositional pattern restored: changes to Avatar will propagate here automatically. C6 Fixed

recommendations.headline: Add size variants.
recommendations.body: Current 48×48 container is fixed — bigger groups (5+ avatars) benefit from a larger container for readability. Propose groupSize = small | medium | large with appropriate inner avatar sizes.

recommendations.headline: Deprecate the duplicate Avatar at 21:94766.
recommendations.body: Now that Avatar Group points at the canonical 17143:4488, the duplicate should be marked deprecated and removed in a future DS cleanup pass.

specCards.swift: EBAvatarGroup(avatars: members) // Renders Pair (2 avatars) automatically when members.count == 2
specCards.compose: EBAvatarGroup(avatars = members) // Renders Pair (2 avatars) automatically when members.size == 2

specCards.compose: EBAvatarGroup(avatars = members) // Renders Trio (3 avatars) automatically when members.size == 3

specCards.swift: EBAvatarGroup(avatars: members) // Renders Quad (4 avatars) automatically when members.count == 4

blocks.code: import EastBlueDS import com.eastblue.ds.avatar.*

usageSnippets.swift: // Pair / trio / quad — pass avatars, layout auto-detected from count EBAvatarGroup(avatars: [ EBAvatar(initials: "DM"), EBAvatar(initials: "LM"), EBAvatar(initials: "AB") ]) // Overflow — pass full list + max visible count EBAvatarGroup(avatars: allAvatars, maxVisible: 3) .ebLayout(.overflow) // renders 3 avatars + "+N" if allAvatars.count > 3
usageSnippets.compose: // Pair / trio / quad — pass avatars, layout auto-detected from count EBAvatarGroup( avatars = listOf( Avatar(initials = "DM"), Avatar(initials = "LM"), Avatar(initials = "AB") ) ) // Overflow — pass full list + maxVisible EBAvatarGroup( avatars = allAvatars, maxVisible = 3, layout = EBAvatarGroupLayout.Overflow )

accessibility.ios: Decorative if not tappable — use .accessibilityHidden(true) on individual avatars
48 × 48 container meets iOS HIG when whole group is tappable

usageGuidelines.doText: Use Avatar Group for 2–4 participants in a list item, header, or shared-with indicator.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Use for counts above 4 without an overflow "+N" badge — users can't infer total count from a cluster alone.

usageGuidelines.doText: Provide a single group-level accessibility label listing all participants.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Let each avatar announce separately — creates VoiceOver/TalkBack noise.

scorecard.notes: Semantic names: Avatar, container. Top-level component set uses "Avatar Group" — clean.
Property is layout with semantic values — pair, trio, quad, overflow. Clean native enum mapping.
All colors bound to Avatar's tokens. Inherits the same typo in intials — tracked under Avatar's open issues.
Maps to stacked avatars via ZStack (iOS) / Box + offset (Compose). Fixed 48×48 and layout=pair/trio/quad don't match a dynamic native list — API should accept an array.
layout=overflow shows three avatars and a "+N" badge in the fourth slot, covering groups larger than four.
Inner avatars are instances of the canonical Avatar, so changes to Avatar carry through.

variants.description: 1 layout setting × 4 values (pair, overflow, quad, trio) = 4 variants.

rows.body: Property renamed — no. of initals → layout. Values changed from pseudo-numeric strings (2/3/4/5+) to semantic enum values (pair/trio/quad/overflow). Fixes typo, spaces, and dots in one pass. Clean native enum mapping. Fixed
Overflow variant added — layout=overflow displays 3 avatars + a "+N" badge in the 4th slot. Handles groups larger than 4. Added

Inner avatars repointed to canonical Avatar — Previously referenced a duplicate Avatar component at 21:94766. All 4 variants now use instances of the canonical Avatar at 17143:4488. Compositional inheritance restored. Swapped
Component assessed — 3 variants (2/3/4 avatars) in a fixed 48×48 container. Used for participant lists, collaboration indicators. Documented
Property name has typo and spaces — no. of initals: missing second "i", contains dot + space. Values are strings instead of integers. Blocks native enum mapping. Fixed in 1.1.0
No overflow variant — Component supports only 2/3/4 avatars. Most DS patterns include a "+N" overflow badge for groups larger than the max shown. Fixed in 1.1.0

Inner avatars hardcoded, not Avatar instances — The 24px child avatars are duplicated as plain containers inside this component. If the main Avatar changes, this group won't inherit updates. Fixed in 1.1.0
Code Connect mappings — No CLI mappings registered yet. Open
